mapper.sql: c.id, c.item_id, i.title AS item_title, i.type AS item_type, i.status AS item_status, c.applicant_id, au.username AS applicant_name, c.proof, c.answer, c.status, c.review_opinion, c.reviewer_id, ru.username AS reviewer_name, c.handover_by, hb.username AS handover_by_name, c.created_at, c.updated_at
i.hidden_feature AS item_hidden_feature, i.verify_question AS item_verify_question, i.verify_answer AS item_verify_answer
FROM claim c LEFT JOIN item i ON i.id = c.item_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = c.applicant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = c.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user hb ON hb.id = c.handover_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO claim (item_id, applicant_id, proof, answer, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{applicantId}, #{proof}, #{answer}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM claim WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM claim WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND applicant_id = #{applicantId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'HANDED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM claim WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'HANDED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE claim SET status = #{status}, review_opinion = #{reviewOpinion}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE claim SET status = #{status}, review_opinion = #{reviewOpinion}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE claim SET status = #{status}, handover_by = #{handoverBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
